entry.title: DropKick ⚽️ - A minimal commit/reveal PQ rescue protocol
entry.summary: The discussion within the Bitcoin Development Mailing List emphasizes the reliance of the commit/reveal mechanism on the existence of a valid Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Unspent Transaction Output (UTXO). This suggests that the mechanism cannot serve as an initial solution for Bitcoin systems that are delaying updates or improvements; rather, it is applicable only to individual users who are procrastinating. The effectiveness of the commit/reveal strategy hinges on the prior deployment of a robust PQC solution specifically tailored for Bitcoin. This necessity underlines the importance of having a foundational PQC system in place before such mechanisms can be effectively implemented to address user-level issues.
